measurement.order: sequential executor subprocesses; alternating path order per trial
measurement.scope: bounded synchronous integer clamp/control; no speed or application claim
measurement.trial: fresh owner; only action timed; preparation/checking/cleanup excluded
measurement.validation: fresh untimed pair before warmups and measured trials; integer oracle
measurement.warmup: discarded fresh pair; no retained guest cache
